judge.reason: The two versions are almost the same. Y differs in four ways. It uses `if defined?(yield); next unless yield file; end` where X uses `next if block_given? && !yield(file)`, and both behave the same. Y also prints a debug `$stderr.puts` line for every file it hashes, which is noisy output it adds rather than a feature it drops. It also leaves a commented-out Dir.glob alternative in place and has trailing whitespace in a doc comment. Neither version drops behaviour the other has. X is cleaner and simpler to read and change.
